svg.title: Use the extra income, not the new total
svg.desc: Two fictional upgrades: A costs 120 tokens and adds 4 per second, recovering its cost in 30 seconds. B costs 180 and adds 9, recovering its cost in 20 seconds. C costs 300 and adds 10, matching A at 30 seconds. Full equivalent text, source link and an optional direct Cash Empire Clicker App Store link follow.
svg.text: HONEST LITTLE APPS / FICTIONAL GAME MATH
Payback time = cost ÷ extra tokens per second
Both examples start at 10 tokens/s. Rates stay constant.
TIME TO RECOVER THE UPGRADE COST
B costs more, but pays back 10 seconds sooner.
120 ÷ 14 and 180 ÷ 19 include income you already had.
They give the wrong comparison for the upgrade alone.
EQUAL PAYBACK DOES NOT MEAN EQUAL COST
Same payback; different upfront tokens and extra rate.
Original Cash Empire companion • not native gameplay • no real-money value
